limitations: Queue prioritizes unresolved, ambiguous, and registry-nonmatch published FDA letters.
Existing registry links still require full independent regulatory outcome and predecision evidence adjudication.
Registry nonmatch is not an FDA rejection or proof that the application will never be approved.
FDA selectively releases CRLs; the corpus cannot establish a complete review-cycle denominator.
Records are quarantined and cannot be used for HOP model training.
